confusions: The seal/open choice with Reeve vs. Gray Priest felt consequential but the game revealed the king ultimately decides at rest anyway—this is good design but might confuse players who expect binding commitment
suggestions: Scholar class reads verses directly with no puzzle, making the path very linear—consider optional challenges or flavor text in verse locations
Barrow has unexplored side rooms (crypt, strongbox)—could hint at their value to encourage exploration
Verse path leads to one ending; offering narrative branches for different verse orders or crown interaction might increase replayability
NPC dialogue was clear but some players might not ask all questions—consider one scripted interaction that clarifies the seal mechanics earlier
